name: project-tracker
description: Local ticket tracker for one developer working with several AI agents.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/web/e2e/tsconfig.json && svelte-check --tsconfig packages/web/tsconfig.json --threshold warning
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
scripts.build: node build.mjs && vite build --config packages/web/vite.config.ts --logLevel warn
